If "Electric 10s" is your usual pick, check this page often. The prize counts change even when the ticket looks the same.
2772.headline: The top prize list got shorter

2774.body:
"The Price is Right™" has joined the Texas lineup at $10 with four top prizes of $250,000. Only on the first day do the printed odds describe the game exactly, because nothing has been won. Starting tomorrow, this page shows how that changes.

The numbers for "The Price is Right™" are recalculated every morning, and this page changes with them.
2774.headline: A brand-new game to watch
